description: This file contains implementation code for managing boot configuration environments in the Cuttlefish Android emulator, including functions to write environment variables, prepare boot environment images, and initialize bootloader environment partitions.

methods.name: WritePausedEntrypoint
methods.description: Writes the entry point command to the environment stream, considering whether the bootloader should pause.

methods.name: WriteAndroidEnvironment
methods.description: Writes Android-specific environment variables to the environment stream.

methods.name: WriteEFIEnvironment
methods.description: Writes EFI boot environment variables based on the instance configuration.

methods.name: WriteEnvironment
methods.description: Constructs and writes the environment variables to a file based on the instance configuration and boot flow.

methods.name: ReplaceKernelBootArgs
methods.description: Replaces 'kernel.' with a space in kernel boot arguments.

methods.name: PrepareBootEnvImage
methods.description: Prepares the boot environment image, including generating environment variables, creating the image, and adding hash footers.

methods.name: InitBootloaderEnvPartition
methods.description: Initializes the bootloader environment partition based on the instance configuration.
